conformal.note: calibrated on the validation split, which also selected the model: coverage on new rows is approximate; rows must be distributed like the validation rows

importance.note: the drop of the metric when the field's values are shuffled across the validation rows; a field the model never reads drops nothing, a field two others can stand in for drops little

notes: ranking uses the validation split only (balanced_accuracy); the test split is not used for selection
